docs.text: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of renewal.
Admins add seats under Settings, Team, Seats.
SSO is available on the Enterprise plan only.
Invoices are emailed on the first of each month.
Reset your password from the sign-in page link.
To export your data open Settings, choose Privacy, pick Export, then wait for the email with the download link.
API keys live under Settings, Developer, Keys.
Cancel any time under Settings, Billing, Cancel.
The Team plan allows 1000 requests per minute.
Turn on two-factor login under Settings, Security.
